rules.statement: Orders under section 4(2) of the Ordinance do not give an indefeasible title to claimants, as they are merely admissions and not agreements on mutual concession between claimant and Crown.
rules.supporting_quote: "I fail to see how the fact that the shareholders who do not come forward may claim a share of a land mentioned in an Order under section 4 -(i) could possibly affect the rights of the Crown to lands declared to be the property of the Crown by the conclusive Order referred to in 2 (2)."
